title: Lead QA Engineer
description:
### **How to contribute to our vision**

To ensure business continuity within the Fleet Operations Management Applications team following an internal transition, we are seeking a Lead QA Engineer in India to drive testing excellence for the RACE initiative. This senior\-level role is critical to maintaining the high quality and reliability of our digital products and software application engineering solutions. To address these business aims, this role focuses on QA leadership and mentorship, test strategy and execution excellence, and continuous process improvement. These areas directly support our goal of delivering robust software applications through structured testing methodologies and comprehensive documentation. Given the focus on quality leadership and technical test execution, the ideal candidate will have extensive experience in software test engineering, hands\-on test automation, and proven capability in guiding QA teams.

### **What You Need To Make a Difference**

* **40% QA Leadership \& Team Mentorship**
 + Guide and mentor QA team members to ensure high\-quality test execution and professional growth
 + Foster thorough test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and execution reports
 + Coordinate QA activities across the team to align with sprint goals and RACE initiative timelines
* **30% Test Strategy, Automation \& Execution**
 + Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for web, mobile and server applications
 + Execute comprehensive test suites (functional, regression, integration, and performance) with excellence
 + Ensure strict alignment of testing processes with software engineering standards and product requirements
* **30% Quality Improvement \& Collaboration**
 + Drive continuous improvements in testing methodologies, tools, and QA processes
 + Collaborate closely with Product Owners, developers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and resolve defects
 + Analyze test results and quality metrics to identify risks and suggest proactive mitigation strategies

### **Certifications**

* ISTQB Certified Tester Advanced Level (CTAL)

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline
* 6\-8 years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, with a proven track record of leading or mentoring QA teams
* Strong experience in test automation, agile methodologies, and test lifecycle management within a product development environment

### **Skills**

* **QA Leadership \& Methodology**
 + QA Team Leadership \& Mentoring
 + Test Strategy \& Planning
 + Quality Metrics \& Reporting
 + Technical Documentation
* **Test Automation \& Technical Skills**
 + Test Automation Frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright)
 + API \& Web Application Testing
 + Regression \& Integration Testing
 + Defect Lifecycle Management
* **Software Engineering \& Collaboration**
 + Agile/Scrum Methodologies
 + CI/CD Integration
 + Cross\-functional Collaboration

Graduate

title: Sub System Test Engineer – ATS - Railway Infrastructure
description:
**Hello Visionary!**

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.

**We are looking for a Sub System Test Engineer: ATS \- Railway Infrastructure**

Work assignments:

Responsibility for the test execution and test management of mass transit rollouts of ATS for CBTC/ Non\-CBTC signaling Systems as part of large\-scale railway infrastructure projects. Ensuring economic success and (internal) customer satisfaction for ATS domain in CBTC/ Non\-CBTC application projects. Carrying responsibility for the lab data testing scope. Representation of the Test Team within a project when communicating to internal stakeholders, whilst reporting to the line management (test manager/group lead). Ensuring compliance with defined procedures/processes.

Exploration of further business opportunities:

Identification and exploitation of additional business opportunities during project implementation, e.g. identifying Change Requests or extending the scope towards project needs.

**You’ll make a difference by:**

* Preparation of test checklist specific to project and Create test specification / test cases as per ATS design requirement specifications.
* Responsible for lab data testing of ATS Sub\-systems in Test lab using real and simulated test environments.
* Review / verification of all documents related to Lab data testing.
* Evaluation of project, customer, internal requirements towards implementing suitable project specific test cases and test documentation.
* Detailed knowhow on functional aspects of ATS and its interface with other subsystems like ATC and IxL with CBTC/non\-CBTC projects.
* Knowledge about testing and commissioning process and Strategy.
* Work with development team to identify and capture test cases, ensure version management
* Knowledge of test automation for HMI/UI testing
* Setting up of test environments, writing test scripts and implementing test cases/scenarios.
* Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned people.
* Reviewing test logs and results to identify failures, raising CFXs in the change and defect management tool, participating in CCB meetings, and providing test inputs.
* Interfacing/Clarification with senior test engineer, test manager, System Manager/Sub PM, Validation, RAMS and project teams.
* Collaborating with HQ teams towards tooling requirements, developing/adapting templates/schematics, and parameterization.
* Able to support installation and tests activities/teams onsite if required.
* Understanding of other subsystems like Interlocking, ATC, Communication and Diagnostic Systems.
* Knowledge of Projects Support functions (RM/DM/CM) and Quality Management.

Essential Soft and Hard skills for IXL Functional Tester:

* Basic Knowledge of Linux.
* Experience with VMware.
* Networking knowledge.
* Troubleshooting skills for the Test Environment.
* Ability to understand and implement IP addressing, subnetting, interface configuration, routing principles, and gateway setup.
* Fundamental understanding of server environments, including ESXi and Windows.
* Practical experience with Siemens products, particularly WKII, R9k, TGMT, and TG200, will be an added advantage.

**You’ll win us over by:**

* Degree in electrical or electronics engineering.
* Professional experience of minimum 5 years in railway transportation systems (Main line / Mass Transit) with the focus on testing on ATS sub\-system (CBTC / Non CBTC).
* Performed hands on testing activities for ATS subsystem besides understanding of operational scenarios, requirements, and interfaces.
* Experience with Functional testing, lab testing, test setups. Experience with Integration tests and SAT would be an added advantage.
* Proficient English essential both written and oral, knowledge of German/Spanish is an asset
* Independent and structured approach to work.

**Join us and be yourself!**

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams, impacting entire cities, countries \- and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

**Find out more about Siemens careers at:** www.siemens.com/careers **\& more about mobility at** https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html

**Job Title:** Senior QA Engineer**Department:** Quality Assurance**Location:** Mumbai (on\-site, Monday to Friday Work From Office)**Experience:** 4\+ years **About the Role:** 

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own end\-to\-end quality for one or more of our product areas spanning mobile apps, embedded device firmware, and cloud services. You will drive test strategy, lead release sign\-offs, build and extend test automation, and mentor junior testers. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable doing deep exploratory testing on a physical device and writing automation code that runs in CI. **Key Responsibilities:** 

* Own the test strategy, test planning, and release quality for an assigned product area, from requirement review through production sign\-off.
* Review PRDs and technical designs early, identify gaps, edge cases, and risks, and influence the team toward testable, robust designs.
* Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive functional, regression, integration, performance, and compatibility test suites across Android/iOS apps, device firmware, and backend APIs.
* Build and maintain automated test suites (mobile UI, API, and device\-level) and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline; drive automation coverage targets for your area.
* Lead root\-cause analysis of complex, intermittent, and hardware–software interaction issues (connectivity, OTA, audio/video, sensor behaviour, app–device sync) using logs, device tools, and debugging utilities.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation pass rate, release readiness) and present release quality status to engineering and product stakeholders.
* Act as the QA point of contact for developers, product managers, and support teams for your area; triage production escalations and drive them to closure.
* Mentor and review the work of junior testers, establish best practices for test case design and bug reporting, and contribute to the team's QA process and tooling improvements.
* Contribute to release planning, risk assessments, and go/no\-go decisions.

 **Required Skills and Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* 4 \+ years of hands\-on QA experience, with at least 2 years testing mobile applications and/or hardware or IoT products.
* Strong command of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, risk\-based testing, regression strategy, and defect life\-cycle management.
* Proven experience with test automation: at least one of Appium, Selenium, or Playwright, plus strong scripting skills in Python or Java.
* Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or Pytest with requests) and a working understanding of REST, JSON, authentication, and backend data flows.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Android/iOS debugging tools (adb, logcat, Xcode Instruments, Charles/Proxyman) and with testing across device fragmentation and OS versions.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and using Git.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Linux command line.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently and drive outcomes with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience testing embedded/IoT devices, robotics, or consumer electronics, including firmware, OTA updates, BLE/Wi\-Fi provisioning, and audio/video pipelines.

 **Good to Have:** 

* Familiarity with testing AI/ML\-driven features such as speech recognition, conversational responses, or vision\-based interactions, including non\-deterministic output validation.
* Understanding of child\-safety, privacy, and compliance requirements (COPPA, GDPR\-K) for products designed for children.
* ISTQB Foundation or equivalent certification.

 **What We Offer:** 

* Ownership of quality for AI\-powered products used by children and families worldwide.
* A senior seat in a small, high\-impact QA team with direct influence on product and engineering decisions.
* Opportunity to shape the automation roadmap and grow into an architect track.

title: Sr. AI Engineer 4B
description:
Sr. AI Engineer**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?** 

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges. 

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment. 

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises. 

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled QA Tester to join our Advanced AI Practice within the AI Application Engineering team. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building test automation and wants to grow into testing the next generation of Generative AI and Agentic AI applications. You will build and execute automated test suites for both traditional application layers (APIs, UI, integrations) and AI\-powered components (LLM responses, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), working under the guidance of senior AI engineers and QA/test leads.

Key Responsibilities

**Test automation development:** Build, maintain, and execute automated test scripts for functional, integration, and regression testing using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Jmeter or Playwright.

**API testing:** Design and execute REST API test cases for application services and AI/model endpoints (request/response validation, contract testing, negative testing).

**AI/LLM output testing:** Support testing of GenAI and agentic application behavior including validating LLM responses against expected outcomes, checking for consistency, and flagging hallucinations or incorrect outputs using defined test datasets and evaluation criteria.

**End\-to\-end suite development:** Contribute to building and extending end\-to\-end automation suites covering UI, API, and data layers of AI\-powered applications.

**CI/CD integration:** Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) to enable continuous testing.

**Cloud testing:** Execute and validate test cases for applications deployed on AWS or Azure environments.

**Defect management:** Log, track, and triage defects using Jira/HP ALM; collaborate with developers and DevOps engineers to drive issues to closure.

**Test documentation \& reporting:** Prepare test cases, test data, execution reports, and coverage metrics for functional and AI\-specific test cycles.

**Test strategy support:** Assist senior QA engineers and leads in defining test plans and strategies for new AI/GenAI features under their guidance.

**Continuous learning:** Stay current with evolving AI/LLM testing methodologies, tools, and industry practices, and bring improvement ideas to the team.

Must\-Have Skills \& Experience (Mandatory)

**3\+ years of hands\-on experience** in QA/Test Automation Engineering especially in AI application development.

**Strong programming skills in Java or Python** for test script development.

**Hands\-on experience with key automation framework**s: Selenium, Cypress, Jmeter or Playwright.

**Solid experience in API testing (REST APIs)** using tools such as Postman or RestAssured.

**Practical experience in Functional, Integration, and Regression testing.**

**Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).

**Working knowledge of Git/GitHub** for version control.

**Understanding of cloud testing concepts** on AWS and Azure.

**Foundational understanding of AI concepts, LLMs, and AI\-specific testing considerations** (e.g., prompt\-response validation, output consistency checks).

**Familiarity with test/defect management tools** such as Jira or HPALM.

description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

NEC Software Solutions (India)

On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This

change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be

part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology

and innovation.

We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services

across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by

consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready

software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user

experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are

a hub for offshore support and technology services.

We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial

services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our

customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.

For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india.

About NEC Corporation

NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics

company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative

Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that

promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to

help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.

NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and

network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a

brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid

changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social

values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable

world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.

For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Exposure

We work in an environment where Developers are more exposed to IT and systems in production and the IT professionals are more exposed to the software development process. By focusing on this level of exposure it allows us to build a team more equipped to deal with incidents and requests. It also allows developers and IT professionals to provide more efficient services. As a Full Stack Developer specializing in Java and React, you will be at the forefront of building, optimizing, and maintaining our web applications. You'll work closely with cross\-functional teams to design and implement solutions that meet business requirements and enhance user experience.

Job Description:

* Design, develop, and enhance general application software and specialized programs.
* Analyze user requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Customize and optimize software applications to improve performance and operational efficiency.
* Participate actively in the complete product development lifecycle
* Design, develop, and maintain robust full\-stack applications using modern technologies.
* Build and optimize backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* Develop responsive, user\-friendly interfaces using React and Next.js.
* Design and consume RESTful APIs for seamless system integration.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile development environment.
* Ensure high\-quality code delivery within defined timelines while taking full ownership of assigned tasks.
Desired Candidate Profile:

Graduate: B.Tech /B.E. \- Any Specialization, BCA

Post Graduate: M.Tech/ M.E. – Computers; MCA Computers; Post Graduation Not Mandatory

Required Skills:

* Strong hands\-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate, React.js and Next.js.
* Expertise in REST API development and integration.
* Experience with MSSQL or MySQL databases.
* Solid understanding of microservices architecture.
* Strong knowledge of object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with Git or other distributed version control systems.
Good to Have:

* Experience with Node.js and Express.js.
* Familiarity with Document Databases (e.g., Elasticsearch), Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j), and NoSQL databases.
* Exposure to Azure cloud services.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Docker, Jenkins, and Kubernetes.
Key Competencies:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies.
* Experience working in Agile methodologies.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within teams and work with diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to manage workload, prioritize tasks, and perform effectively under pressure.
* Professional, approachable, and positive attitude when working with internal and external teams.
* Commitment to continuous self\-development and career growth.
This is a hybrid role, requiring 3 days a week in the Magarpatta City, Pune office. We offer a culture of openness and transparency, providing an environment conducive to growth and success.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to

dakshata.parab@necsws.com

Regards,

Dakshata

title: Software Engineer II
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Software Engineer II
Job Title: 

Senior BizOps Engineer 

Job Description Summary 

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview 

Account Solution provides valued added services to payment transactions as part of Authorization and Clearing functions.

The Account Solutions BizOps team is looking for a Sr Engineer who can help us solve problems, build our CI/CD pipeline and lead Mastercard in DevOps automation and best practices.

* Are you a born problem solver who loves to figure out how something works?
* Are you a CI/CD geek who loves all things automation?
* Do you have a low tolerance for manual work and look to automate everything you can?

The role of business operations is to be the production readiness steward for the platform. This is accomplished by closely partnering with developers to design, build, implement, and support technology services. A business operations engineer will ensure operational criteria like system availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, self\-healing, and deployment automation are implemented throughout the delivery process. Business Operations plays a key role in leading the DevOps transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change and standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations.

We accomplish this transformation through supporting daily operations with a hyper focus on triage and then root cause by understanding the business impact of our products. The goal of every biz ops team is to shift left to be more proactive and upfront in the development process, and to proactively manage production and change activities to maximize customer experience, and increase the overall value of supported applications. Biz Ops teams also focus on risk management by tying all our activities together with an overarching responsibility for compliance and risk mitigation across all our environments. A biz ops focus is also on streamlining and standardizing traditional application specific support activities and centralizing points of interaction for both internal and external partners by communicating effectively with all key stakeholders.

Ultimately, the role of biz ops is to align Product and Customer Focused priorities with Operational needs. We regularly review our run state not only from an internal perspective, but also understanding and providing the feedback loop to our development partners on how we can improve the customer experience of our applications. 

Role 

* Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through deployment, operations, and refinement.
* Analyze ITSM activities of the platform and provide feedback loop to development teams on operational gaps or resiliency concerns
* Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews.
* Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
* Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
* Support the application CI/CD pipeline for promoting software into higher environments through validation and operational gating, and lead Mastercard in DevOps automation and best practices.
* Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.
* Take a holistic approach to problem solving, by connecting the dots during a production event thru the various technology stack that makes up the platform, to optimize mean time to recover
* Work with a global team spread across tech hubs in multiple geographies and time zones
* Share knowledge and mentor junior resources.

All about you

* Batchelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding
* Experience in Java, Unix and SQL (DB2/Oracle) is must
* Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline management, and software design.
* Systematic problem\-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Ability to help debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
* We support many different stakeholders. Experience in dealing with difficult situations and making decisions with a sense of urgency is needed.
* Interest in designing, analyzing and troubleshooting large\-scale distributed systems.
* We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritise needs and to build relationships is a must.
* Experience in industry standard CI/CD tools like Git/BitBucket, Jenkins, Maven, Artifactory, and Chef. Experience designing and implementing an effective and efficient CI/CD flow that gets code from dev to prod with high quality and minimal manual effort is desired.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

Job Description
**01 About LeadSquared**

LeadSquared is one of the fastest\-growing SaaS companies in the CRM space — trusted by 1,700\+ customers and 2 lakh\+ users globally. We help organisations run high\-velocity sales through intelligent automation, enabling teams to close more, faster. Backed by Stakeboat Capital and Gaja Capital, our 1,300\+ strong team spans India, the US, Middle East, ASEAN, ANZ, and South Africa.

BFSI — banks, NBFCs, housing finance companies, insurers, and digital lenders — is one of LeadSquared's largest and most mission\-critical verticals, powering digital lending and insurance sales journeys where uptime, accuracy, and compliance directly affect our customers' business.

**Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech**

Deloitte Fast 50

**Marketing Automation of the Year**

Frost \& Sullivan 2019

**FT 1000 High\-Growth Asia\-Pacific**

Financial Times

**Top Rated Product**

G2 · GetApp · TrustRadius

**02 The Opportunity**

Product Support at LeadSquared is not a call centre. It is a critical, high\-impact role that sits at the intersection of technology, customer relationships, and product improvement — and within the BFSI vertical, it also sits at the intersection of compliance and business continuity. You are the expert BFSI customers turn to when a disbursement is stuck, a policy workflow breaks, or an integration with a bureau or KYC provider fails — and your ability to solve, communicate, and empathise directly shapes their experience with LeadSquared.

*We are looking for people who love making customers successful — who feel the customer's pain, own the problem, and don't rest until it's resolved, especially when a fix carries real business and regulatory stakes for a bank, NBFC, or insurer.*

**03 ️ What You'll Do**

* Take full ownership of customer issues — from the first touchpoint to complete resolution

* Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues across the LeadSquared platform with speed and precision, including issues within loan/policy origination workflows and disbursement or renewal pipelines

* Ask sharp, targeted questions to get to the root cause — fast, including tracing failures across bureau checks, eKYC/eSign steps, and other BFSI\-specific integrations

* Guide customers through solutions via phone, email, and chat with patience and clarity — often engaging credit, risk, operations, or compliance teams on the customer side

* Deliver resolution within SLA timelines — every time, without exception — with heightened urgency around issues that block disbursements, collections, or regulatory reporting deadlines

* Work closely with engineering and product teams to surface bugs, patterns, and improvement opportunities specific to BFSI workflows and integrations

* Manage and exceed customer expectations — turn every support interaction into a trust\-building moment with compliance\-conscious BFSI stakeholders

* Contribute to the knowledge base — write clear technical articles, scripts, and diagnostic guides, including BFSI\-specific troubleshooting playbooks

* Support customer onboarding — deliver product training (web and in\-person) for admins and end users at banks, NBFCs, and insurance companies

**04 ✅ Must Have**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in product/technical support for a web\-based SaaS platform

* Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose complex issues systematically and efficiently

* Solid understanding of APIs, Webhooks, and Connectors

* Excellent written and verbal communication — clear, empathetic, and professional, including when navigating compliance\-sensitive conversations

* Experience working with North American and/or Indian enterprise customers; experience with BFSI (banking, NBFC, insurance, or fintech lending) customers is a strong plus

* Ability to work in a 24/7 shift environment

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of at least one programming language — PHP, Java, or Python

* Experience with CRM or marketing automation platforms

* Exposure to core banking systems, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), or Loan Management Systems (LMS) — e.g., FinnOne, Newgen, Lentra, or similar

* Familiarity with BFSI\-specific integrations — credit bureau checks (CIBIL/Experian/CRIF), eKYC/Aadhaar\-based verification, DigiLocker, or eSign

* Basic awareness of RBI/IRDAI regulatory guidelines relevant to digital lending or insurance distribution

* Ability to create proof\-of\-concept solutions, sample scripts, and diagnostic tools

**05 Key Metrics You'll Own**

* ️

**First Response Time**

Speed matters — always

**SLA Adherence**

Zero misses, every ticket

**CSAT Score**

Delight, don't just resolve

**KB Contribution**

Share knowledge, scale impact

**Escalation Rate**

Solve more, escalate less

**06 How You'll Embody Our Values**

At LeadSquared, this role is not just a function — it's a reflection of who we are as a company. Here's how your work ties to our core values:

* **Customer Obsession**

Every ticket, every call, every chat — the customer comes first, whether it's a bank, an NBFC, or an insurer.

* **Empathy**

You feel the frustration of a stuck disbursement or blocked policy issuance. You own the fix. You follow through.

* **Ownership**

No escalation until you've exhausted every option. You own it.

* **Integrity**

You set realistic expectations and always deliver on your word — critical when compliance deadlines are on the line.

* **Innovation**

You don't just fix — you find smarter ways to prevent issues across BFSI\-specific workflows.

* **Collaboration**

You are the bridge between BFSI customers and the product team.

**07 Why LeadSquared**

* **Fast\-Paced Growth**

Work in an environment where impact is visible and rewarded quickly

**Best Minds**

Collaborate with industry leaders and product innovators

**Accelerated Career**

Performance\-driven growth — your trajectory is in your hands

**Open Leadership**

Easily approachable management — ideas are heard and acted on

**BFSI Leadership**

Work at the centre of one of the fastest\-growing BFSI CRM and lending automation practices in the market

* **Flexible Environment**

A culture that trusts its people to deliver on their own terms

*If you believe great support in BFSI is not about closing tickets — it's about earning the trust of a bank, an NBFC, or an insurer when it matters most — we want you on this team.*

**Apply at: careers.leadsquared.com**

description:
**This role is for one of our clients** 

Industry: Banking and Financial Services 

Seniority level: Associate level 

Min Experience: 2\+ years 

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, Bengaluru 

JobType: full\-time

We’re looking for a **Forward Deployment Engineer** to work at the intersection of engineering, product and the business.

As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will take technology from **prototype to production** by working directly with internal stakeholders to understand real\-world problems, rapidly build and integrate solutions, and deploy them into production environments.

This is a highly hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys operating close to the customer, moving quickly from ambiguity to working software, and taking ownership beyond writing code.

You will partner with product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, develop solutions, validate them in real environments and scale successful implementations across NatWest.

**What you’ll do**

* Work directly with business and product teams to understand complex problems and translate them into technical solutions.
* Rapidly prototype, build and deploy production\-quality applications and integrations.
* Own solutions end\-to\-end \- from discovery and technical design through development, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Embed with teams and operate close to the problem rather than working purely as a central engineering function.
* Integrate applications with existing platforms, APIs, data sources and enterprise systems.
* Develop reusable components, services and patterns that can be scaled across teams.
* Work across the full engineering lifecycle, including coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and production support.
* Diagnose technical issues in live environments and work collaboratively to resolve them.
* Partner with architecture, security, platform and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards.
* Use data, experimentation and user feedback to iterate rapidly and demonstrate measurable impact.
* Help identify where emerging technologies, including AI and GenAI, can solve meaningful business problems.
* Document solutions and share learnings so successful approaches can be adopted more broadly.
* Influence engineering practices and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

**What we’re looking for**

**Engineering**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building production applications.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as **Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or C\#**.
* **Strong proficiency in AI/ML, GenAI, LLM applications, AI agents and Data engineering or analytics**
* Experience designing and consuming **REST APIs, microservices and distributed systems**.
* Experience with **cloud technologies**, preferably GCP, AWS or Azure.
* Strong understanding of databases, data structures and system integration.
* Experience with **Git, CI/CD, automated testing and modern software development practices**.
* Understanding of observability, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
* Experience working with containers and/or Kubernetes.

**Forward deployment mindset**

* Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning loosely defined problems into working solutions.
* Able to move quickly between **discovery, prototyping and production engineering**.
* Strong customer and stakeholder orientation.
* Comfortable working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging capability.
* Pragmatic: knows when to build quickly, when to engineer for scale and when to reuse an existing capability.
* Takes ownership for outcomes rather than only technical deliverables.

**Advantageous experience**

Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:

* Cloud\-native application development
* API and platform integration
* DevOps / SRE
* Financial services or other highly regulated environments
* Enterprise technology transformation
* Rapid prototyping / innovation engineering

**What success looks like**

In this role, success isn’t simply measured by the amount of code you write.

You will be successful when you can:

**Understand Build Deploy Adopt Scale**

* Turn a business problem into a viable technical solution.
* Get a working solution into the hands of users quickly.
* Build trust with stakeholders through technical expertise and delivery.
* Take solutions into production safely and sustainably.
* Demonstrate measurable business or customer impact.
* Turn successful experiments into reusable engineering capabilities.

**Why this role is different**

The Forward Deployment Engineer operates **where the problem is**, not just where the engineering team sits.

You will have the opportunity to combine the depth of a software engineer with the curiosity of a product thinker and the stakeholder skills of a solutions engineer.

You’ll work on problems where the solution isn’t always known upfront \- and you’ll be expected to discover, build and deploy the answer.

For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com. 

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description – Test Automation**

**Designation \- Senior Test Analyst (5\-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 \-12\+ years)**

Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.

You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.

You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C\#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.

You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.

Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well\-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.

You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a ‘can do’ mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
* Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
* Promote shift\-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
* Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service\-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
* Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
* Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
* Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents.

Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
* Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
* Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work.
* Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
* Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
* Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.

**Required technical skills and experience**

* Experience with C\# / Java Script/ Type Script
* 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
* Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
* Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment

**Required soft skills and experience**

* Clear and concise communicator
* Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
* Able to work independently and as part of a team
* Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
* Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
* Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers \& business owners.

**Desirable skills and experience**

* Experience using Azure DevOps
* Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
* Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud\-based tools
* Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc

description:
**Job Title:** Senior QA Engineer**Department:** Quality Assurance**Location:** Mumbai (on\-site, Monday to Friday Work From Office)**Experience:** 4\+ years **About the Role:** 

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own end\-to\-end quality for one or more of our product areas spanning mobile apps, embedded device firmware, and cloud services. You will drive test strategy, lead release sign\-offs, build and extend test automation, and mentor junior testers. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable doing deep exploratory testing on a physical device and writing automation code that runs in CI. **Key Responsibilities:** 

* Own the test strategy, test planning, and release quality for an assigned product area, from requirement review through production sign\-off.
* Review PRDs and technical designs early, identify gaps, edge cases, and risks, and influence the team toward testable, robust designs.
* Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive functional, regression, integration, performance, and compatibility test suites across Android/iOS apps, device firmware, and backend APIs.
* Build and maintain automated test suites (mobile UI, API, and device\-level) and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline; drive automation coverage targets for your area.
* Lead root\-cause analysis of complex, intermittent, and hardware–software interaction issues (connectivity, OTA, audio/video, sensor behaviour, app–device sync) using logs, device tools, and debugging utilities.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation pass rate, release readiness) and present release quality status to engineering and product stakeholders.
* Act as the QA point of contact for developers, product managers, and support teams for your area; triage production escalations and drive them to closure.
* Mentor and review the work of junior testers, establish best practices for test case design and bug reporting, and contribute to the team's QA process and tooling improvements.
* Contribute to release planning, risk assessments, and go/no\-go decisions.

 **Required Skills and Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* 4 \+ years of hands\-on QA experience, with at least 2 years testing mobile applications and/or hardware or IoT products.
* Strong command of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, risk\-based testing, regression strategy, and defect life\-cycle management.
* Proven experience with test automation: at least one of Appium, Selenium, or Playwright, plus strong scripting skills in Python or Java.
* Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or Pytest with requests) and a working understanding of REST, JSON, authentication, and backend data flows.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Android/iOS debugging tools (adb, logcat, Xcode Instruments, Charles/Proxyman) and with testing across device fragmentation and OS versions.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and using Git.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Linux command line.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently and drive outcomes with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience testing embedded/IoT devices, robotics, or consumer electronics, including firmware, OTA updates, BLE/Wi\-Fi provisioning, and audio/video pipelines.

 **Good to Have:** 

* Familiarity with testing AI/ML\-driven features such as speech recognition, conversational responses, or vision\-based interactions, including non\-deterministic output validation.
* Understanding of child\-safety, privacy, and compliance requirements (COPPA, GDPR\-K) for products designed for children.
* ISTQB Foundation or equivalent certification.

 **What We Offer:** 

* Ownership of quality for AI\-powered products used by children and families worldwide.
* A senior seat in a small, high\-impact QA team with direct influence on product and engineering decisions.
* Opportunity to shape the automation roadmap and grow into an architect track.

description:
QA Lead / Senior QA Lead – Manual Testing \& Automation

**Job Type:** Full\-time 
**Experience:** 6\+ Years 
**Leadership Experience:** 2\+ Years 
**Function:** Quality Assurance / Software Testing 
**Work Mode:** Navi Mumbai 
**Industry:** IT / SaaS / Product

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Senior QA Lead / QA Lead** to lead our manual testing team and own the testing strategy and quality standards across our highest\-stakes products.

This is a **hands\-on leadership role**. You will lead and mentor the QA team while remaining actively involved in testing complex and high\-risk product areas.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in **manual testing, test strategy, QA process setup, release\-readiness, defect RCA, WebSockets, and automation using Python \+ Selenium**.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering and Leadership to ensure that quality is measurable, risks are clearly communicated, and releases meet defined QA standards.

Key ResponsibilitiesQA Strategy \& Process

* Define and own QA processes and test strategies for complex products and client projects.
* Build and maintain **test plans, test scenarios, coverage matrices and traceability**.
* Establish testing standards for complex business logic and integration\-heavy products.
* Improve QA processes, documentation and overall testing maturity.

Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop the manual testing team.
* Review test cases and test scenarios and improve test\-design quality.
* Coach testers on edge\-case thinking, coverage and defect identification.
* Improve the quality and effectiveness of defect reporting.
* Establish clear QA standards and hold the team accountable to them.

Release Readiness

* Own **QA release\-readiness and sign\-off** across products.
* Ensure releases have documented and executed test coverage.
* Make objective go/no\-go quality recommendations based on actual testing results.
* Maintain QA independence from delivery and schedule pressure.

Defect RCA \& Quality Improvement

* Lead **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** for escaped defects.
* Identify why defects escaped — coverage gaps, regression gaps, handoff issues, rushed sign\-off, etc.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring defects.
* Track quality trends and identify areas requiring improvement.

Hands\-on Testing

* Remain hands\-on with testing of the most complex and highest\-risk areas.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory and scenario\-based testing.
* Test complex areas involving:
* Payments and multi\-currency workflows
* Role\-based access and permissions
* Multi\-tenant data isolation
* Sensitive / regulated data
* Integration\-heavy business logic
* WebSockets and real\-time functionality

Automation

* Contribute to and support automation initiatives.
* Identify suitable areas for automation and help build the automation roadmap.
* Work with **Python \+ Selenium** for automated testing.
* Help establish a long\-term automation strategy alongside the manual QA function.

Reporting \& Stakeholder Management

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries. 

**What Success Looks Like** 

The successful candidate will help move the organization further toward an SRE operating model by reducing manual operations, improving observability, and engineering automation for recurring operational activities. 

The engineer should be proactive rather than waiting for every task to be assigned. We are looking for someone who identifies repetitive work, reliability risks, monitoring gaps, and opportunities for automation and then takes ownership of developing the solution. 

During production incidents, the engineer should actively investigate, communicate findings, recommend actions, and remain engaged through resolution. 

The role will primarily focus on SRE, automation, DevOps, monitoring, and reliability engineering, while maintaining enough infrastructure and Windows expertise to contribute to the broader operational responsibilities of the team 

**Role Summary** 

We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Site Reliability Engineer to improve the reliability, availability, automation, and operational efficiency of business\-critical platforms. 

The role focuses on Site Reliability Engineering practices, with a strong emphasis on automation, proactive monitoring, incident ownership, disaster recovery, and continuous improvement. 

The position supports production infrastructure across Azure, and on\-premises environments. The engineer will work across multiple technologies and platforms, including Windows infrastructure, with a focus on reducing manual operational work and improving service reliability. 

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Site Reliability Engineering \& Automation**

* Design and develop automation to reduce repetitive manual operational tasks.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Integrate infrastructure automation into enterprise CI/CD and DevOps pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and related technologies.
* Develop reusable automation rather than one\-off scripts.
* Identify reliability risks and opportunities for automation and proactively drive improvements.
* Develop automated health checks, validation, remediation, and reporting.

**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience**

* Design and implement automation for disaster recovery activities across multiple products.
* Automate failover, failback, infrastructure validation, application validation, and customer validation.
* Reduce manual intervention during DR exercises and recovery events.
* Develop reusable DR automation that can be adopted across multiple products.
* Improve system availability, resiliency, and recoverability.

**Monitoring \& Observability** 

Improve monitoring, observability, and alerting using Grafana and other enterprise monitoring platforms. 

* Develop and automate monitoring plugins and health checks.
* Automate monitoring configuration and deployment.
* Improve proactive detection of infrastructure and application issues.
* Reduce unnecessary alerts and improve actionable monitoring.
* Develop automated remediation where appropriate.

**Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering**

* Support production infrastructure across Azure, virtualized, and on\-premises environments.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, maintenance, and validation.
* Support high availability and resilient infrastructure architectures.
* Automate patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and compliance validation.
* Integrate existing Ansible\-based infrastructure and security automation into enterprise DevOps pipelines.
* Collaborate with cloud, network, database, middleware, security, application, and infrastructure teams.

**Windows \& Production Operations**

* Provide hands\-on support for Windows Server infrastructure as part of the broader production environment.
* Troubleshoot Windows services, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, networking, certificates, authentication, and operating system issues.
* Support Windows patching, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Develop automation to reduce manual Windows administration.
* Participate in production maintenance and disaster recovery activities

**Incident Management \& Reliability**

* Participate in Sev1/2/3 production incidents and take technical ownership through service restoration.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application\-related issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions for recurring problems.
* Remain actively engaged during incidents and communicate technical findings and recommended actions.

Identify patterns from incidents and convert them into monitoring, automation, or reliability improvements. 

* 

Embed AI into project delivery to drive productivity, automate routine activities, strengthen decision quality through trusted data, and deliver continuous process improvement while applying appropriate human judgement

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience :** **5\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems engineering.** 

* Strong hands\-on scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with CI/CD and enterprise DevOps platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Experience with Ansible or similar configuration\-management technologies.
* Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code technologies.
* Experience supporting cloud infrastructure in Azure, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting business\-critical production environments.
* Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, failover, and failback.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.
* Strong production troubleshooting and incident\-management skills.

Ability to independently identify opportunities for improvement and drive engineering solutions through completion. 

* 

Preferred Qualifications 

* Strong PowerShell and/or Python experience.
* Microsoft Azure infrastructure experience.
* Azure DevOps.
* Azure Site Recovery.
* Kubernetes or AKS.
* Grafana and Prometheus.
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with vulnerability\-management and privileged\-access technologies.
* Experience automating patching, security hardening, vulnerability remediation, or compliance controls.
* Experience supporting financial services, payments, or other highly available regulated environments.

Familiarity with SRE practices including SLI/SLO concepts and reducing operational toil. 

* 

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health \& Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

* Proven problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, strong team player, and the ability to work with multiple other IT disciplines and business functions in a fast\-paced, high\-productivity environment.
* Experience in building and maintaining applications that are mission critical.
* Quality Driven

JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited, requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. This position shall actively ensure that his/her own activities and those of all employees within the project meet this obligation. JBPCO critical standards and procedures related to expected conduct are detailed on the company website. This position is expected to be familiar with these policies and ensure that they are implemented in all areas of control.

title: Senior Director, Data Platform Services
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Organizational \& People Leadership

* Own the leadership, structure, and outcome of multiple engineering teams delivering Infinia S3, POSIX, and NFS offerings, with teams located in India and internationally.
* Build and scale an agile, high\-performing engineering organization: strong technical bar, high accountability, and a culture where teams take genuine ownership of what they ship.
* Recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and engineers; build a durable leadership bench across all sites.
* Set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and run rigorous, fair performance and career development processes for the org.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive culture across a geographically distributed team, ensuring engineers everywhere feel equally informed, included, and empowered.
* Champion developer experience across the organization: streamlined onboarding, clear documentation, and low\-friction tooling, so engineers at every site can ramp quickly and stay productive.

End\-to\-End Execution \& Delivery Ownership

* Own execution end to end for the S3, POSIX, and NFS offerings, from planning and prioritization through delivery, quality, and production readiness.
* Define and continuously improve the engineering processes, release practices, and quality gates that let distributed teams ship enterprise\-grade software predictably.
* Track delivery against commitments; proactively surface risks, trade\-offs, and blockers to stakeholders and drive them to resolution.
* Ensure consistent engineering standards and practices across all teams and locations, so quality and velocity don't vary by geography.
* Drive adoption of modern engineering practices and AI\-assisted development tools as a standard part of how the organization works.
* Continuously invest in engineering productivity: build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and internal tooling, to reduce cycle time and maximize the org's shipping velocity.

Technical Leadership

* Bring a strong technical grounding in data platforms and storage systems to engage credibly in architecture, design, and technical trade\-off discussions.
* Partner with architects and senior engineers to ensure technical decisions support scalability, reliability, and performance at enterprise scale.
* Balance short\-term delivery pressure against long\-term technical health, ensuring the teams invest appropriately in maintainability and technical debt.
* Embed quality as a first\-class engineering discipline: testing, observability, and reliability practices built into the development lifecycle rather than bolted on at the end.

Cross\-Timezone \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Work effectively across multiple time zones, with particular emphasis on close, sustained collaboration with executive stakeholders based in the US.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Foundation
description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit's strategy is to be an AI\-driven expert platform, delivering world\-class, revolutionary experiences for our customers at unprecedented speed and scale. The AI Foundation (AIF) Platform team builds and operates the evaluation infrastructure, ML pipelines, and observability tooling that Intuit's agentic product teams (QBO, TurboTax, and others) rely on to ship AI agents safely and quickly. Come join AIF as a Staff Software Engineer to help build the platform that lets the rest of Intuit bring trustworthy, high\-quality AI agents to market fast.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and build backend services and pipelines in Python that power agent evaluation, observability, and quality measurement at Intuit scale
* Own and evolve core components of the eval platform — golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, trajectory and correctness scoring, and regression detection across agent releases
* Build and operate agent observability infrastructure using Langfuse (or equivalent OTel\-based tracing), ensuring product teams have real\-time visibility into agent behavior, latency, and failure modes
* Design, author, and maintain ML pipelines using Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), including DAG authoring, artifact tracking, caching/memoization, and deployment on internal Kubernetes (IKS) infrastructure
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership of initiatives — from design through production launch — partnering closely with product agent teams to understand their evaluation and observability needs
* Champion a builder culture: experiment with customers to find the best solutions, take on ambiguous problems, and iterate quickly
* Use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate your own engineering workflow, and help shape how the broader platform team adopts AI\-native development practices
* Design and develop highly scalable, high\-performance distributed applications and services; expect roughly 80–95% hands\-on development/coding.
* Mentor and coach other engineers on software engineering best practices, platform architecture, and AI/agent evaluation concepts
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and other engineering teams to define what "quality" means for an agent and how the platform measures and guarantees it

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelors of engineering in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* 10\+ years of experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production
* Strong proficiency in Python; solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals (APIs, data modeling, testing, CI/CD)
* Hands\-on experience with LLM/agent systems: prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, LLM\-as\-judge evaluation, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph)
* Experience with ML pipeline orchestration — Kubeflow Pipelines, Argo Workflows, or similar — including pipeline authoring, artifact/versioning, and Kubernetes\-based deployment
* Familiarity with observability/tracing systems for LLM or distributed applications (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, or comparable)
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Self\-starter who can operate with minimal guidance in a fast\-moving, ambiguous AI landscape
* Strong problem\-solving skills, a track record of shipping, and excellent verbal/written communication
* Outstanding cross\-functional partnership skills; comfortable working with data scientists and product teams, not just engineers

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Meet the Team
 
Cisco Networking builds industry\-leading switching, routing, wireless, and cloud\-managed networking solutions used by customers worldwide. We are looking for a hands\-on senior firmware engineer with strong systems programming and networking expertise to help develop the next generation of high\-performance switching software.
 
Join the Network Connectivity team, where you will design and develop production\-grade firmware and system software for enterprise switching platforms. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently own significant features, contribute to technical design and architecture decisions, and work closely with networking, platform, quality, and product teams.

Your Impact
 
In this role, your work will directly enhance the connectivity, reliability, and configuration of L2/L3 protocols on Cisco switching platforms. You will own medium\-to\-large features from design through delivery, troubleshoot complex device and customer issues, and help raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment and mentorship.
 
Responsibilities
 
* Design, develop, and own networking components that are simple, scalable, reliable, and supportable. Develop firmware and system software for Cisco switching products.
* Analyze requirements and problem statements, evaluate technical trade\-offs, and produce clear software designs, detailed design documents, and functional specifications.
* Write high\-quality C/C\+\+ code and unit tests. Apply strong white\-box testing and automation practices. Triage, debug, and root\-cause software bring\-up issues, regressions, crashes, performance problems, and customer failures.
* Work with local and remote teams to review product requirements, software functional/design specifications, unit and integration test plans, and validation strategy. Partner closely with system test and quality teams to ensure feature readiness.
* Contribute innovative ideas that improve product architecture, debuggability, performance, reliability, and engineering productivity, including opportunities to create intellectual property.

**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, EE/ECE, or a related field, with typically 4\-8 years of relevant software/firmware development experience.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in C/C\+\+ with solid data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, memory management, and debugging skills.
* Hands\-on experience developing firmware, embedded software, or system software for networking products.
* Strong experience with concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization, and IPC/RPC mechanisms.
* Strong L2/L3 networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP/LAG, ARP, IPv4/IPv6, routing fundamentals, packet flow, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong Linux/system programming fundamentals and hands\-on debugging experience using tools such as GDB, core dumps, packet captures, Wireshark/tcpdump, and traffic generators/analyzers such as IXIA or equivalent.
* Demonstrated ownership of medium\-to\-large technical features, including design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production/customer support. Ability to mentor engineers and contribute effectively to design and code reviews.
* Hands\-on experience using GenAI\-assisted development tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and security.

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Hands\-on development and debugging experience with networking protocols and switching features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MST, LACP/LAG, UDLD, Storm Control, QoS, OSPF, BGP, ECMP, multicast, DHCP relay, SLAAC, or VRRP.
* Experience with Python or another scripting language for test automation, debugging, tooling, or developer productivity.
* Experience with hardware/software bring\-up, SDK/ASIC interaction, packet processing, or high\-performance data\-plane software is a plus. Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE are desirable.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
 
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Disclaimer
 
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.
