On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation.

We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market\-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services.

We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two\-person startups to $bn listed companies.

For more information, visit at www.necsws.com/india .

**About NEC Corporation**

NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a ‘Top 50 Innovative Company’ globally and the NEC Group globally provides “Solutions for Society” that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies.

NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of “Orchestrating a brighter world.” NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential.

For more information, visit NEC at https://www.nec.com. 

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Description – Test Automation**

**Designation \- Senior Test Analyst (5\-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 \-12\+ years)**

Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.

You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.

You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C\#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.

You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.

Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well\-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.

You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a ‘can do’ mindset.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
* Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
* Promote shift\-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
* Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service\-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
* Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
* Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
* Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents.

Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
* Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
* Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work.
* Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
* Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
* Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.

**Required technical skills and experience**

* Experience with C\# / Java Script/ Type Script
* 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
* Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
* Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment

**Required soft skills and experience**

* Clear and concise communicator
* Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
* Able to work independently and as part of a team
* Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
* Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
* Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers \& business owners.

**Desirable skills and experience**

* Experience using Azure DevOps
* Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
* Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud\-based tools
* Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc
* Usage of latest AI tools.
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
* Experience testing User Interfaces and databases
* You'll have ISTQB/ISEB Foundation certifications or equivalent certifications or be working towards achieving them.
* Experience coordinating with external/Offshore QA resources

Graduate

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Senior QA Engineer**Department:** Quality Assurance**Location:** Mumbai (on\-site, Monday to Friday Work From Office)**Experience:** 4\+ years **About the Role:** 

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own end\-to\-end quality for one or more of our product areas spanning mobile apps, embedded device firmware, and cloud services. You will drive test strategy, lead release sign\-offs, build and extend test automation, and mentor junior testers. This role suits someone who is equally comfortable doing deep exploratory testing on a physical device and writing automation code that runs in CI. **Key Responsibilities:** 

* Own the test strategy, test planning, and release quality for an assigned product area, from requirement review through production sign\-off.
* Review PRDs and technical designs early, identify gaps, edge cases, and risks, and influence the team toward testable, robust designs.
* Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive functional, regression, integration, performance, and compatibility test suites across Android/iOS apps, device firmware, and backend APIs.
* Build and maintain automated test suites (mobile UI, API, and device\-level) and integrate them into the CI/CD pipeline; drive automation coverage targets for your area.
* Lead root\-cause analysis of complex, intermittent, and hardware–software interaction issues (connectivity, OTA, audio/video, sensor behaviour, app–device sync) using logs, device tools, and debugging utilities.
* Define and track quality metrics (defect leakage, test coverage, automation pass rate, release readiness) and present release quality status to engineering and product stakeholders.
* Act as the QA point of contact for developers, product managers, and support teams for your area; triage production escalations and drive them to closure.
* Mentor and review the work of junior testers, establish best practices for test case design and bug reporting, and contribute to the team's QA process and tooling improvements.
* Contribute to release planning, risk assessments, and go/no\-go decisions.

 **Required Skills and Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics, or a related field.
* 4 \+ years of hands\-on QA experience, with at least 2 years testing mobile applications and/or hardware or IoT products.
* Strong command of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, risk\-based testing, regression strategy, and defect life\-cycle management.
* Proven experience with test automation: at least one of Appium, Selenium, or Playwright, plus strong scripting skills in Python or Java.
* Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or Pytest with requests) and a working understanding of REST, JSON, authentication, and backend data flows.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Android/iOS debugging tools (adb, logcat, Xcode Instruments, Charles/Proxyman) and with testing across device fragmentation and OS versions.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and using Git.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Linux command line.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently and drive outcomes with cross\-functional teams.
* Experience testing embedded/IoT devices, robotics, or consumer electronics, including firmware, OTA updates, BLE/Wi\-Fi provisioning, and audio/video pipelines.

 **Good to Have:** 

* Familiarity with testing AI/ML\-driven features such as speech recognition, conversational responses, or vision\-based interactions, including non\-deterministic output validation.
* Understanding of child\-safety, privacy, and compliance requirements (COPPA, GDPR\-K) for products designed for children.
* ISTQB Foundation or equivalent certification.

 **What We Offer:** 

* Ownership of quality for AI\-powered products used by children and families worldwide.

title: QA Manager
description:
QA Lead / Senior QA Lead – Manual Testing \& Automation

**Job Type:** Full\-time 
**Experience:** 6\+ Years 
**Leadership Experience:** 2\+ Years 
**Function:** Quality Assurance / Software Testing 
**Work Mode:** Navi Mumbai 
**Industry:** IT / SaaS / Product

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Senior QA Lead / QA Lead** to lead our manual testing team and own the testing strategy and quality standards across our highest\-stakes products.

This is a **hands\-on leadership role**. You will lead and mentor the QA team while remaining actively involved in testing complex and high\-risk product areas.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in **manual testing, test strategy, QA process setup, release\-readiness, defect RCA, WebSockets, and automation using Python \+ Selenium**.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering and Leadership to ensure that quality is measurable, risks are clearly communicated, and releases meet defined QA standards.

Key ResponsibilitiesQA Strategy \& Process

* Define and own QA processes and test strategies for complex products and client projects.
* Build and maintain **test plans, test scenarios, coverage matrices and traceability**.
* Establish testing standards for complex business logic and integration\-heavy products.
* Improve QA processes, documentation and overall testing maturity.

Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop the manual testing team.
* Review test cases and test scenarios and improve test\-design quality.
* Coach testers on edge\-case thinking, coverage and defect identification.
* Improve the quality and effectiveness of defect reporting.
* Establish clear QA standards and hold the team accountable to them.

Release Readiness

* Own **QA release\-readiness and sign\-off** across products.
* Ensure releases have documented and executed test coverage.
* Make objective go/no\-go quality recommendations based on actual testing results.
* Maintain QA independence from delivery and schedule pressure.

Defect RCA \& Quality Improvement

* Lead **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** for escaped defects.
* Identify why defects escaped — coverage gaps, regression gaps, handoff issues, rushed sign\-off, etc.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions to reduce recurring defects.
* Track quality trends and identify areas requiring improvement.

Hands\-on Testing

* Remain hands\-on with testing of the most complex and highest\-risk areas.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory and scenario\-based testing.
* Test complex areas involving:
* Payments and multi\-currency workflows
* Role\-based access and permissions
* Multi\-tenant data isolation
* Sensitive / regulated data
* Integration\-heavy business logic
* WebSockets and real\-time functionality

Automation

* Contribute to and support automation initiatives.
* Identify suitable areas for automation and help build the automation roadmap.
* Work with **Python \+ Selenium** for automated testing.
* Help establish a long\-term automation strategy alongside the manual QA function.

Reporting \& Stakeholder Management

* Report quality status, risks, defects and trends to senior leadership.
* Provide clear visibility into release readiness and product quality.
* Coordinate testing across multiple products and complex client projects.
* Maintain accurate QA records in **Zoho Projects, Zoho Desk, Jira or similar tools**.

Required Qualifications

* **6\+ years of overall QA / Software Testing experience**
* **2\+ years of experience leading or mentoring a QA/testing team**
* Proven experience **owning test strategy and QA processes**
* Strong hands\-on **manual testing** experience
* Experience creating **test plans, coverage frameworks and traceability**
* Experience owning **release\-readiness / go\-no\-go QA decisions**
* Strong experience conducting **RCA for escaped defects**
* Experience testing complex products involving:
* Payments
* Multi\-tenant applications / data isolation
* Sensitive or regulated data
* Strong leadership, mentoring and team\-management skills
* Strong defect tracking and test management experience
* Experience with **Zoho, Jira or similar tools**
* **WebSockets experience – Mandatory**
* **Automation experience – Mandatory**
* Minimum **2 years of automation experience using Python \+ Selenium – Mandatory**

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience developing or implementing a QA automation strategy
* API testing experience
* Performance testing experience
* Experience in **Payments, Healthcare, EdTech**, or products handling children's data
* **ISTQB Advanced** certification or equivalent
* Experience working in SaaS / product\-based environments

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can **lead from the front** — a QA professional who can manage a team while still testing the hardest problems themselves.

You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying quality risks, giving direct feedback, and making evidence\-based release recommendations.

The role requires someone who can establish **strong QA standards, improve testing maturity, mentor the team and take ownership of product quality**.

**If you have strong manual QA leadership experience combined with hands\-on Python \+ Selenium automation and WebSockets testing pls share cv poojatalentconsultant@gmail.com with np, ctc, expected ctc and if ok for mumbai.**

**QA Lead \| QA Manager \| Manual Testing \| Software Testing \| Test Strategy \| Test Planning \| Test Cases \| Test Management \| Regression Testing \| Functional Testing \| Integration Testing \| Exploratory Testing \| Defect Management \| RCA \| Release Management \| Release Readiness \| Python \| Selenium \| Test Automation \| WebSockets \| API Testing \| Jira \| Zoho \| SaaS \| Product Testing**

description:

 As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) at Ferguson, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and services that support our eCommerce platform. **Required Qualifications:** 

* 4\+ years of software development experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React.js.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.

* Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
* Experience with Redis or similar caching solutions.
* Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized and Kubernetes\-based environments across cloud and/or on\-premises platforms.

* Experience working with global teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Experience building eCommerce, retail, distribution, marketplace, or other customer\-facing digital applications.

**Key Technologies:** 

 React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, GraphQL, REST APIs, Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture, PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases), Redis (or similar caching solutions), Kubernetes, CI/CD, Git, and/or On\-Premises Platforms, Node.js (preferred).

 At Ferguson, we believe the work we do should align with our values, create meaningful relationships, offer flexibility, and promote a sense of pride. description:
Senior Fullstack Developer – Epiroc Mining India Private Ltd, Bengaluru

 Join us as a Senior Fullstack Developer in our Research and Development department within the Corporate Units at Epiroc. This role is a pivotal technical position based in Bengaluru, where you'll contribute directly to advancing cutting\-edge offboard automation and connected operations platforms in the mining industry.

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain high\-performance applications primarily using WPF, C\#, .NET Core, React 18, and MVVM architecture. Your expertise will be critical in driving innovative software solutions that support sustainable mining operations globally.

 You will work closely with cross\-functional teams including product managers, QA, and fellow developers to define and deliver features that delight users and meet stringent performance and security standards. Your scope will include both client and server\-side development, integration of RESTful APIs and microservices, and leveraging AI\-driven tools to enhance development efficiency and test automation.

 Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain scalable .NET and ReactJS applications with a focus on high performance, security, and maintainability.
* Lead and mentor junior developers, fostering a collaborative, process\-oriented culture that prioritizes continuous learning and Agile methodologies.
* Drive architectural design and provide technical leadership for distributed systems that leverage networking protocols such as TCP/IP and UDP to ensure scalable and secure communication.
* Implement robust software testing strategies, including automated integration and unit testing using frameworks such as XUnit, NUnit, or MSTest, incorporating AI agents to streamline the SDLC.
* Manage database operations utilizing SQL Server, Entity Framework, and NoSQL technologies for optimal application data handling.
* Coordinate Agile/Scrum processes, potentially acting as Scrum Master, to ensure timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes.
* Utilize AI coding assistants like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot effectively, incorporating context engineering and agentic workflows to accelerate development.
* Integrate third\-party libraries and external services, ensuring seamless data exchange and system interoperability.
* Identify and implement performance tuning and memory management improvements for smooth application execution.
* Champion secure coding practices aligned with industry standards to protect application integrity and data privacy.
* Collaborate on forward\-looking technical roadmaps and influence architectural decisions that support sustainable innovation and time\-to\-market objectives.

 Who We're Looking For

 We seek an accomplished developer with a comprehensive skill set across front\-end and back\-end technologies. Your strong command of C\#, .NET Core/.NET Framework, React 18, and MVVM architecture will be foundational to success, complemented by proficiency in XAML, WPF animations, and asynchronous programming.

 Experience with AI\-assisted development tools and modern DevOps practices including Git, CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps or Jenkins is essential. You demonstrate strong problem\-solving abilities and thrive in Agile environments with excellent communication and team collaboration skills. Your familiarity with networking protocols and microservices architecture further strengthens your capability to build reliable distributed systems.

 Why Join Epiroc?

 This position offers remarkable technical visibility, providing the chance to collaborate with global teams and impact the design of next\-generation offboard automation platforms. You will engage in projects driving innovation and shaping the future of connected mining technology, working with scalable, secure, and high\-performance applications that embody Epiroc's commitment to sustainability and excellence.

 At Epiroc, we foster a culture of creativity, respect, and continuous improvement, supporting your professional growth while making a tangible difference in the world through technology.

 Behaviors \& Values

 Successful individuals in this role will exemplify leadership in driving scalable and secure platforms, delivering solutions that are reliable and future\-ready. You operate with deep technical expertise, while actively collaborating across departments to align with Epiroc's strategic innovation and sustainability objectives. Your proactive approach and dedication to quality contribute directly to accelerated time\-to\-market and customer satisfaction.

 Apply Today

 Become an integral part of Epiroc’s R\&D team and help build software that empowers connected and autonomous mining operations worldwide. If you are passionate about leveraging your fullstack development experience to innovate and lead in a dynamic environment, this opportunity awaits you.

**It all starts with people.** 
 The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

 All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future. Learn more at www.epiroc.com

description:
**Description**
 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams where there is an air gap in the tech stack. The tech team in RBS develops automation that leverages Machine/Deep Learning to scale execution of these high complex tasks that currently require human cognitive skills. Our solutions ensure that information in Amazon's catalog is complete, correct and, comprehensive enough to give Amazon customers a great shopping experience every time. We are building solutions to move towards retail automation and are using latest technology like LLM to solve business problems.

 We believe in “Work Hard. Have Fun. Make History” value by having a strong focus on sharing learning experiences from the front line with the development teams. So, the options for people in the team are vast. If you like mastering a domain and going deep, we need you. If you can juggle three tasks and coordinate with multiple people in the heat of an incident, we need you. If you love the benefits of process and methodical improvement, you will love it here. If you want to keep your head down, headphones on, and bash out code to support the team, we have a spot for you too.

 At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA.

 We are seeking a Software Development Engineer who can design and develop systems for its businesses. As an SDE, you would have immense opportunity to explore avenues of how to model things, figure out right abstraction level, take judgement calls around multiple design trade offs at hand that influence a multi billion dollar business.

 We are looking for highly talented software development engineers who are passionate not only about architecting and developing large scale distributed technology solutions but also innovating new ideas and providing directions to our business. You will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth of our businesses. In this process you will drive best practices, mentor other engineers, drive continuous improvements in engineering and operational excellence. You will use technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. As a SDE with RBS team, you will work with talented peers of SDEs and Applied scientists to build robust engineering platforms to solve high impact issues. You will constantly stretch the boundaries of innovation to tackle the business challenges.

 If you enjoy designing and building highly distributed systems that can scale and solving challenging problems, come to join us!

 Work/Life Balance

 RBS Tech team puts a high value on work\-life harmony. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life\-long happiness and we encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

 Mentorship \& Career Growth

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring, detailed and constructive code reviews. We have casual coffee chats with Principal \& Senior Engineers from RBS tech. You get an opportunity to network and have technical conversations around your work, technical challenges, suggestions, ideas and proposals. You can also seek advice and discuss about things outside work, like, life in general, your family, hobbies etc. We provide trainings to the employees through online learning platforms such as O'reilly and also encourage them to take up AWS/ML certifications.

 Key job responsibilities

 We are looking for an experienced Software developer with a diverse skillset and background. As a SDE\-2, your work is consistently of high quality. You solve difficult problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. You work with your team to invent, design and build software that is stable and performant. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You limit the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You make appropriate trade\-offs, re\-use where possible, and are judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., system hardware, database, memory/CPU, etc.). You work on project ideas with customers, stakeholders, and peers. You help your team evolve by actively participating in the code review process, design discussions, team planning, and ticket/metric reviews. You focus on operational excellence, constructively identifying problems and proposing solutions. You work on software enhancements that improve team software and processes. You are able to train new members on how team’s software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend (Java, Spring Boot)
description:
**Job Description**

 We are looking for a motivated and hands\-on
 **Senior Software Engineer** 
 to join the CRONUS Platform Team and strengthen the Identity module for Portfolio Brands. The role will focus on building secure, reliable and scalable backend services that support customer registration, login, authentication, authorization and personal\-data protection.

 You will work with engineers, product managers, architects, security specialists and business stakeholders to improve Customer Identity and Access Management capabilities across Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle, including design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring and production support.

 This is a long\-term strategic role with strong ownership. Over time, there will be opportunities to take broader technical leadership responsibilities within the team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

 As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver secure customer identity capabilities and production\-grade backend services.

 Key responsibilities include:

* Design, build and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Develop and improve customer identity journeys, including registration, sign\-in, password reset, account recovery, multi\-factor authentication and social login.
* Integrate backend services with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID and other customer identity platforms.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization using OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and token\-based security.
* Build reliable APIs and integrations for customer profile, consent, newsletter and related customer capabilities.
* Protect customer and personal data through secure design, access controls, privacy\-aware data handling and appropriate operational controls.
* Design services for scalability, reliability, performance and maintainability.
* Improve observability through effective logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and alerts.
* Own services across the full lifecycle, including automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
* Investigate technical issues and production incidents, identify root causes and implement long\-term improvements.
* Collaborate with security, architecture, product and engineering teams to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
* Review code, support engineering standards, mentor colleagues and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs clearly.
* Contribute to the future evolution of the CIAM landscape, including the adoption of new identity platforms such as Strivacity.

**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**

 The CRONUS Platform Team is part of Portfolio Brands Tech and supports the digital commerce platform used by Weekday, COS, ARKET and \&Other Stories. The team owns shared platform capabilities that help the brands deliver stable, secure and reliable customer experiences.

 The Platform Team works across five capability areas:

* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Shared backend services and system\-to\-system integration services.
* **Site Reliability Engineering:** 
 Reliability, availability, monitoring, alerts and performance engineering.
* **Automation:** 
 Quality automation using Playwright and process automation using RPA.
* **Operations:** 
 Incident management, problem management and platform stability.
* **Security \& Compliance:** 
 Security engineering, audits and compliance.

 You will work mainly within Backend Engineering and the Identity module, while collaborating closely with SRE, operations, automation, security and other product teams. The team values end\-to\-end ownership, open communication, shared learning and practical solutions that improve customer experience and business reliability.

**WHO YOU ARE**

 We are looking for someone with strong backend engineering and customer identity experience, along with a collaborative and ownership\-driven mindset.

* **Overall Experience:** 
 8\-10 years of relevant software engineering experience, including designing, developing, testing and operating backend applications or services.
* **Java:** 
 Strong and recent hands\-on experience with Java 17\+ and core Java concepts, including object\-oriented design, collections, exception handling, concurrency and clean code.
* **Spring Boot:** 
 Practical experience building production\-grade REST APIs and microservices using Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem.
* **IAM / CIAM:** 
 Meaningful hands\-on experience with customer identity and access management, including authentication, authorization, user identity, access control, identity journeys, customer profiles, consent and personal\-data protection.
* **Azure B2C:** 
 Experience with Azure AD B2C / Microsoft Entra External ID or a comparable CIAM platform. You should understand user flows or policies, registration, MFA, social identity providers, tokens and backend integration.
* **Identity Standards:** 
 Good understanding of OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and token lifecycle management.
* **Backend Engineering:** 
 Strong experience with API design, microservices, secure coding, databases, system integrations, performance, reliability and production support.
* **Cloud \& Containers:** 
 Experience with cloud\-native development, Docker and Kubernetes. Azure experience is preferred.
* **CI/CD:** 
 Experience with automated build, test and deployment pipelines.
* **Databases:** 
 Practical experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, for example PostgreSQL or Cosmos DB.
* **Testing:** 
 Experience with unit, integration, contract, security and performance testing.
* **Observability:** 
 Experience with logging, monitoring, metrics, tracing and production alerting.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with event\-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Azure Service Bus or similar technologies.
* Experience migrating between customer identity platforms or modernizing an existing CIAM solution.
* Exposure to Strivacity or another modern customer identity platform.
* Experience working with customer consent, preference or newsletter capabilities.
* Experience in e\-commerce or another high\-traffic customer\-facing digital platform.

**And people who are**

* Passionate about secure, reliable and simple customer experiences.
* Comfortable taking ownership and moving complex work from problem to production.
* Collaborative team players who work well in global, cross\-functional environments.
* Proactive problem\-solvers who balance technical quality with practical delivery.
* Able to explain technical choices, risks and trade\-offs in clear language.
* Interested in mentoring colleagues and growing into broader technical leadership responsibilities.
* Curious and adaptable as technologies and identity platforms evolve.

**WHO WE ARE** 
**​**

 H\&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

 We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

 Help us re\-imagine fashion and together we will re\-shape our industry. Learn more about H\&M here.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE** 
**​**

 At H\&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

 We offer all our employees at H\&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H\&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H\&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H\&M HOME, \& Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H\&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H\&M Incentive Program here.

 In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

**JOIN US** 
**​**

 Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: Sr. Software Engineer- Enterprise Platform
description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

 Join us to transform the way the world works.

**Job Description**

**Hiring team details:**

 Enterprise Platform Foundations

 Our Vision: Deliver world\-class ease of doing business experience for LinkedIn’s paid customers.

 Our Mission: Build a unified, efficient, secure product platform to accelerate \& maximize the value of LinkedIn’s paid products and services.

 EP Foundations (Enterprise Platform Foundations) is the core platform powering every paid product at LinkedIn. As part of the broader Enterprise Platform (EP) organization, the team provides foundational capabilities used across LinkedIn's enterprise businesses and products.

 The Enterprise Platform organization delivers common services across three key areas:

1. User \& License Management through Admin Center and Account Center (EP Foundations)
2. Digital Goods Management
3. Enterprise Identity \& Access Management

 EP Foundations owns the lifecycle of enterprise entities, including accounts, licenses, profiles, roles, seats, groups, and application instances. EP Foundations serves as a dependency for all major LinkedIn Lines of Business, including Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, Learning, Premium, and emerging products. The team is both a platform and product engineering organization, responsible for the backend systems that power Admin Center while managing some of LinkedIn's most critical enterprise data stores and services. Key responsibilities include managing:

* User identifiers such as Seat ID, User ID, Email, and Member ID.
* Core enterprise entities including Accounts, Application Instances, Profiles, Licenses, User, Groups and Roles.

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

 Responsibilities

 The ideal candidate should have practical experience taking AI/ML solutions from concept or prototype through to production deployment, with a strong understanding of model integration, AI/ML workflows, scalability, performance, and reliability.

 Experience in API development and software engineering is also required, but this will be a secondary focus compared to hands\-on AI/ML expertise.

 Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain production\-grade AI/ML solutions for complex business and technical use cases.
* Develop and implement AI/ML solutions using appropriate models, frameworks, tools, and technologies.
* Work with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI/ML applications where applicable.
* Develop solutions involving RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model integration, and AI workflows.
* Build and integrate AI/ML capabilities into enterprise applications and existing technology ecosystems.
* Evaluate and optimize AI/ML solutions for accuracy, performance, scalability, reliability, and cost.

* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to AI/ML models, applications, integrations, and production environments.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Strong professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with proven hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-level AI/ML solutions.

* Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with Java, C\#, or TypeScript is an added advantage.

* Hands\-on experience with relevant AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit\-learn, Hugging Face, or similar.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries. 

**What Success Looks Like** 

The successful candidate will help move the organization further toward an SRE operating model by reducing manual operations, improving observability, and engineering automation for recurring operational activities. 

The engineer should be proactive rather than waiting for every task to be assigned. We are looking for someone who identifies repetitive work, reliability risks, monitoring gaps, and opportunities for automation and then takes ownership of developing the solution. 

During production incidents, the engineer should actively investigate, communicate findings, recommend actions, and remain engaged through resolution. 

The role will primarily focus on SRE, automation, DevOps, monitoring, and reliability engineering, while maintaining enough infrastructure and Windows expertise to contribute to the broader operational responsibilities of the team 

**Role Summary** 

We are seeking a hands\-on Senior Site Reliability Engineer to improve the reliability, availability, automation, and operational efficiency of business\-critical platforms. 

The role focuses on Site Reliability Engineering practices, with a strong emphasis on automation, proactive monitoring, incident ownership, disaster recovery, and continuous improvement. 

The position supports production infrastructure across Azure, and on\-premises environments. The engineer will work across multiple technologies and platforms, including Windows infrastructure, with a focus on reducing manual operational work and improving service reliability. 

This is a hands\-on individual contributor role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Site Reliability Engineering \& Automation**

* Design and develop automation to reduce repetitive manual operational tasks.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Integrate infrastructure automation into enterprise CI/CD and DevOps pipelines.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform and related technologies.
* Develop reusable automation rather than one\-off scripts.
* Identify reliability risks and opportunities for automation and proactively drive improvements.
* Develop automated health checks, validation, remediation, and reporting.

**Disaster Recovery \& Resilience**

* Design and implement automation for disaster recovery activities across multiple products.
* Automate failover, failback, infrastructure validation, application validation, and customer validation.
* Reduce manual intervention during DR exercises and recovery events.
* Develop reusable DR automation that can be adopted across multiple products.
* Improve system availability, resiliency, and recoverability.

**Monitoring \& Observability** 

Improve monitoring, observability, and alerting using Grafana and other enterprise monitoring platforms. 

* Develop and automate monitoring plugins and health checks.
* Automate monitoring configuration and deployment.
* Improve proactive detection of infrastructure and application issues.
* Reduce unnecessary alerts and improve actionable monitoring.
* Develop automated remediation where appropriate.

**Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering**

* Support production infrastructure across Azure, virtualized, and on\-premises environments.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, maintenance, and validation.
* Support high availability and resilient infrastructure architectures.
* Automate patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and compliance validation.
* Integrate existing Ansible\-based infrastructure and security automation into enterprise DevOps pipelines.
* Collaborate with cloud, network, database, middleware, security, application, and infrastructure teams.

**Windows \& Production Operations**

* Provide hands\-on support for Windows Server infrastructure as part of the broader production environment.
* Troubleshoot Windows services, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, networking, certificates, authentication, and operating system issues.
* Support Windows patching, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Develop automation to reduce manual Windows administration.
* Participate in production maintenance and disaster recovery activities

**Incident Management \& Reliability**

* Participate in Sev1/2/3 production incidents and take technical ownership through service restoration.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application\-related issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions for recurring problems.
* Remain actively engaged during incidents and communicate technical findings and recommended actions.

Identify patterns from incidents and convert them into monitoring, automation, or reliability improvements. 

* 

Embed AI into project delivery to drive productivity, automate routine activities, strengthen decision quality through trusted data, and deliver continuous process improvement while applying appropriate human judgement

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience :** **5\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems engineering.** 

* Strong hands\-on scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience with CI/CD and enterprise DevOps platforms such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent.
* Experience with Ansible or similar configuration\-management technologies.
* Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure\-as\-code technologies.
* Experience supporting cloud infrastructure in Azure, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting business\-critical production environments.
* Understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, failover, and failback.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.
* Strong production troubleshooting and incident\-management skills.

Ability to independently identify opportunities for improvement and drive engineering solutions through completion. 

* 

Preferred Qualifications 

* Strong PowerShell and/or Python experience.
* Microsoft Azure infrastructure experience.
* Azure DevOps.
* Azure Site Recovery.
* Kubernetes or AKS.
* Grafana and Prometheus.
* ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with vulnerability\-management and privileged\-access technologies.
* Experience automating patching, security hardening, vulnerability remediation, or compliance controls.
* Experience supporting financial services, payments, or other highly available regulated environments.

Familiarity with SRE practices including SLI/SLO concepts and reducing operational toil. 

* 

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health \& Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills \& Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

We value strong UI engineering, continuous learning and a pragmatic approach to adopting new technologies, giving you the chance to work with modern .NET, Blazor and AI\-powered development practices while continuing to grow your skills.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Foundation
description:
**Overview**
------------

Intuit's strategy is to be an AI\-driven expert platform, delivering world\-class, revolutionary experiences for our customers at unprecedented speed and scale. The AI Foundation (AIF) Platform team builds and operates the evaluation infrastructure, ML pipelines, and observability tooling that Intuit's agentic product teams (QBO, TurboTax, and others) rely on to ship AI agents safely and quickly. Come join AIF as a Staff Software Engineer to help build the platform that lets the rest of Intuit bring trustworthy, high\-quality AI agents to market fast.

 **Responsibilities**

* Design and build backend services and pipelines in Python that power agent evaluation, observability, and quality measurement at Intuit scale
* Own and evolve core components of the eval platform — golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge pipelines, trajectory and correctness scoring, and regression detection across agent releases
* Build and operate agent observability infrastructure using Langfuse (or equivalent OTel\-based tracing), ensuring product teams have real\-time visibility into agent behavior, latency, and failure modes
* Design, author, and maintain ML pipelines using Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP), including DAG authoring, artifact tracking, caching/memoization, and deployment on internal Kubernetes (IKS) infrastructure
* Drive end\-to\-end ownership of initiatives — from design through production launch — partnering closely with product agent teams to understand their evaluation and observability needs
* Champion a builder culture: experiment with customers to find the best solutions, take on ambiguous problems, and iterate quickly
* Use AI/LLM tooling to accelerate your own engineering workflow, and help shape how the broader platform team adopts AI\-native development practices
* Design and develop highly scalable, high\-performance distributed applications and services; expect roughly 80–95% hands\-on development/coding.
* Mentor and coach other engineers on software engineering best practices, platform architecture, and AI/agent evaluation concepts
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with data scientists, product managers, and other engineering teams to define what "quality" means for an agent and how the platform measures and guarantees it

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelors of engineering in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* 10\+ years of experience building and operating distributed backend systems in production
* Strong proficiency in Python; solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals (APIs, data modeling, testing, CI/CD)
* Hands\-on experience with LLM/agent systems: prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, LLM\-as\-judge evaluation, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph)
* Experience with ML pipeline orchestration — Kubeflow Pipelines, Argo Workflows, or similar — including pipeline authoring, artifact/versioning, and Kubernetes\-based deployment
* Familiarity with observability/tracing systems for LLM or distributed applications (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, or comparable)
* Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
* Self\-starter who can operate with minimal guidance in a fast\-moving, ambiguous AI landscape
* Strong problem\-solving skills, a track record of shipping, and excellent verbal/written communication
* Outstanding cross\-functional partnership skills; comfortable working with data scientists and product teams, not just engineers

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: Software Engineer - C/C++ Networking(Layer2/Layer 3) | 4-8 Years
description:
Meet the Team
 
Cisco Networking builds industry\-leading switching, routing, wireless, and cloud\-managed networking solutions used by customers worldwide. We are looking for a hands\-on senior firmware engineer with strong systems programming and networking expertise to help develop the next generation of high\-performance switching software.
 
Join the Network Connectivity team, where you will design and develop production\-grade firmware and system software for enterprise switching platforms. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently own significant features, contribute to technical design and architecture decisions, and work closely with networking, platform, quality, and product teams.

Your Impact
 
In this role, your work will directly enhance the connectivity, reliability, and configuration of L2/L3 protocols on Cisco switching platforms. You will own medium\-to\-large features from design through delivery, troubleshoot complex device and customer issues, and help raise the engineering bar through strong technical judgment and mentorship.
 
Responsibilities
 
* Design, develop, and own networking components that are simple, scalable, reliable, and supportable. Develop firmware and system software for Cisco switching products.
* Analyze requirements and problem statements, evaluate technical trade\-offs, and produce clear software designs, detailed design documents, and functional specifications.
* Write high\-quality C/C\+\+ code and unit tests. Apply strong white\-box testing and automation practices. Triage, debug, and root\-cause software bring\-up issues, regressions, crashes, performance problems, and customer failures.
* Work with local and remote teams to review product requirements, software functional/design specifications, unit and integration test plans, and validation strategy. Partner closely with system test and quality teams to ensure feature readiness.
* Contribute innovative ideas that improve product architecture, debuggability, performance, reliability, and engineering productivity, including opportunities to create intellectual property.

**Minimum Qualifications:** 

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, EE/ECE, or a related field, with typically 4\-8 years of relevant software/firmware development experience.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in C/C\+\+ with solid data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, memory management, and debugging skills.
* Hands\-on experience developing firmware, embedded software, or system software for networking products.
* Strong experience with concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization, and IPC/RPC mechanisms.
* Strong L2/L3 networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP/LAG, ARP, IPv4/IPv6, routing fundamentals, packet flow, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong Linux/system programming fundamentals and hands\-on debugging experience using tools such as GDB, core dumps, packet captures, Wireshark/tcpdump, and traffic generators/analyzers such as IXIA or equivalent.
* Demonstrated ownership of medium\-to\-large technical features, including design, implementation, testing, rollout, and production/customer support. Ability to mentor engineers and contribute effectively to design and code reviews.
* Hands\-on experience using GenAI\-assisted development tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent to improve engineering productivity while maintaining code quality and security.

**Preferred Qualifications:** 

* Hands\-on development and debugging experience with networking protocols and switching features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MST, LACP/LAG, UDLD, Storm Control, QoS, OSPF, BGP, ECMP, multicast, DHCP relay, SLAAC, or VRRP.
* Experience with Python or another scripting language for test automation, debugging, tooling, or developer productivity.
* Experience with hardware/software bring\-up, SDK/ASIC interaction, packet processing, or high\-performance data\-plane software is a plus. Cisco networking certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or CCIE are desirable.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
 
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Disclaimer
 
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Associate-Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Description
**Job purpose**

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer for a multi\-year strategic transformation program modernizing the global middle\- and back\-office technology platform through a cloud\-native, event\-driven architecture. The platform leverages AWS, Azure, Kafka\-based event streaming, Databricks, modern workflow orchestration, API\-led integration and scalable cloud infrastructure. The Cloud Engineer will help design, build, automate, deploy and support critical cloud infrastructure services spanning both AWS (primary) and Azure environments. The successful candidate will work closely with architects, application development teams, infrastructure engineering, security and data engineering teams to deliver highly resilient, secure and scalable cloud solutions supporting real\-time trade processing, event\-driven integration, analytics and regulatory reporting.

**Key responsibilities**

* Multi\-cloud infrastructure engineering: build and support cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure environments, and implement secure connectivity using technologies such as Megaport, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect, Private Endpoints and VPC/VNet peering.

* Configure and maintain cloud networking, routing, DNS, load balancing and security controls, and support high\-availability and disaster\-recovery designs across multiple availability zones and regions.

* Event\-driven platform engineering: deploy and manage Kafka infrastructure including Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform and Amazon MSK, and implement event\-streaming infrastructure for realtime trade and lifecycle event processing.

* Configure topics, partitions, consumer groups, Schema Registry, ACLs and cluster linking / replication, and support event replay, resiliency, monitoring, recovery and operational controls.

* Cloud automation \& DevOps: develop Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions using Terraform, CloudFormation and Azure Bicep (preferred), and build CI/CD pipelines supporting cloud infrastructure deployments.

* Automate infrastructure provisioning and environment build processes, and contribute to platformengineering standards and reusable deployment modules.

* Platform monitoring \& observability: implement monitoring and alerting for cloud infrastructure and event platforms using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, OpenSearch, Grafana and Prometheus.

* Monitor Kafka consumer lag, throughput, infrastructure utilization, connectivity and operational health.

* Security \& compliance: implement secure cloud controls consistent with financial\-services standards, supporting IAM, Azure Entra ID, RBAC, TLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.

* Partner with Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams during architecture reviews and approvals.

* Data \& analytics platform support: support connectivity and integration between Kafka platforms and Databricks, and implement secure data\-ingestion patterns from real\-time event streams into analytics platforms.

* Assist with cloud storage services including Amazon S3 and Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and support data governance, retention and resiliency requirements.

**Key competencies**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field.

* 4–8 years of cloud engineering experience, including 2\+ years hands\-on AWS and 2\+ years handson Azure.

* Experience supporting production cloud environments within large enterprises and working within Agile delivery teams.

* Strong AWS experience across EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, Route 53, Security Groups and Amazon MSK.

* Strong Azure experience across Azure Networking, Azure Monitor, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage and Entra ID.

* DevOps expertise: Terraform, GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration and Shell or Python scripting.

* Messaging \& integration: Apache Kafka, Confluent, event\-driven architectures, APIs and microservices, and ESB / integration concepts.

* Containers: Docker and Kubernetes (EKS / AKS preferred).

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with Confluent Cloud and Cluster Linking.

* Experience implementing multi\-cloud networking with Megaport.

* Experience building real\-time event\-streaming platforms and working with Databricks.

* Experience in Capital Markets, Investment Banking or Financial Services.

* Understanding of trade lifecycle concepts across FX, Rates, Derivatives and Securities.

* Exposure to event\-driven reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.

* AWS and/or Azure cloud certifications.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Bangalore)
description:
GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains \- processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot\-grade automation in real operational environments. We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission\-critical workflows.

* 

**Tasks**
---------

***Engineering \& Architecture***

* Take full ownership of frontend systems from scoping through delivery — you ask the right questions early, cut through ambiguity, and drive things to completion.
* Make and defend architectural decisions that balance shipping velocity with long\-term maintainability; you know when to build a custom component and when to reach for a proven pattern.
* Build fast, accessible, and reliable interfaces with React and Next.js as your primary stack, with enough full\-stack range to collaborate effectively across Python\-based backend services.
* Evaluate AI tooling critically — you use it daily to move faster, but you understand that vibe coding is a liability, and you hold your AI\-generated output to the same standard as everything else.

***Technical Leadership***

* Lead your squad during planning cycles: go deep on each ticket, challenge scope where needed, and make sure the team ships with clarity.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions — not by micromanaging, but by setting a high bar.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, technical debt, and systemic risks before they become emergencies.

* 

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 8\+ years of hands\-on frontend engineering experience, with a consistent track record of shipping production applications at scale.
* **Technical depth:** TypeScript and React are non\-negotiable. Deep experience with Next.js (App Router, server components, data fetching patterns) is expected. Familiarity with modern styling (Tailwind CSS), state management (Zustand, TanStack Query), and component architecture (Radix UI, headless patterns) is a strong plus.
* **Judgment:** You understand the trade\-off between a pixel\-perfect custom component and a pragmatic library solution — and you know which the situation actually calls for.
* **Ownership:** You don't wait to be told. You identify what needs doing, flag it, and drive it to completion.
* **Discipline:** Detail\-oriented to a fault. You can take over sprint and cycle planning for a squad and make it better — tighter tickets, cleaner scoping, fewer surprises.
* **AI\-native, not AI\-dependent:** You integrate AI tools naturally into your daily workflow for speed and leverage, but you review, reason about, and take full responsibility for everything you ship.
* **Independent thinker:** You form your own technical views, push back when something doesn't make sense, and don't need consensus to act.
* **Supply chain domain experience:** A meaningful plus — we work in a space where understanding warehouse workflows, inventory logic, or ERP\-adjacent systems translates directly into better engineering decisions.

If you are looking for a meaningful career where people work and act with passion, rethink the existing and always strive to find the best solution \- you have come to the right place. We develop future technologies to relentlessly make supply chains better.

 We are a leader in supply chain software solutions, helping organizations streamline operations, reduce costs, and improve efficiency.

 As an OMS Technical Consultant, you will design, configure, integrate, and deploy Infios OMS solutions for global retail and eCommerce clients. Working from Bangalore within an offshore delivery model, you will contribute strong Java engineering expertise to scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and order orchestration workflows. You will collaborate with enterprise architects and stakeholders across the US and EMEA to connect OMS capabilities with eCommerce, ERP, WMS, payment, and other external systems. Your work will span technical design, development, testing, cloud deployment, production readiness, and post\-deployment support across distributed enterprise environments.

**What a Day In The Life Looks Like**
* Design scalable Infios OMS solutions, integration patterns, system data flows, and Java\-based microservices architectures.
* Configure and extend OMS components, pipelines, orchestration logic, business rules, workflows, and data models.
* Develop reusable Java services, REST APIs, and custom extensions using Spring Boot and related Java frameworks.
* Build and support integrations with eCommerce, ERP, WMS, payment, messaging, and other external systems.
* Deploy and test OMS services using AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and, where applicable, Docker and Kubernetes.
* Resolve technical issues, support SIT and UAT, and contribute to production deployments, hypercare, documentation, and effective handovers.

**What You Bring To The Team**
* At least five years of experience working with OMS or distributed commerce systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Infios, formerly Körber, OMS or a similar OMS platform.
* Strong Java development expertise, including Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Experience building scalable backend systems and working with event\-driven architectures.
* Experience with cloud platforms, with AWS preferred, and familiarity with CI/CD practices.
* Knowledge of messaging frameworks such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes is preferred.

**Why join us?**
 At Infios, we're not just looking for employees; we're looking for partners in innovation, growth, and purpose. Meeting you where you are to create the future you need is at the core of who we are and what we do. Whether you're at the beginning of your career or a seasoned expert, we meet you on your journey, equipping you with the tools and opportunities to build the future you envision. Together, we will relentlessly work toward one common goal \- making supply chains better.

**We believe the future is better when supply chains work better.**
 We are an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in the workplace.

 At Infios, we believe that inclusion is a fundamental cornerstone of our success. We are committed to creating a safe and welcoming environment where every individual’s unique experiences and perspectives are valued—whether they look, think, move, believe, or love differently.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, religion, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability during the recruiting process, please let us know at jobs@infios.com

 Disclaimer: This job advertisement is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of all duties or responsibilities that are required for this job. Please note that any salary information is a general guideline only. Individual compensation will be determined by various factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the position, experience, education, skills, location, and market and business considerations. Applications must be submitted via our career site.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

**About Availity India**

 Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong experience in building and scaling cloud\-native, microservices\-based applications. You will be a key contributor to the design, development, and delivery of backend systems, working closely with architects, product managers, and other engineers to build reliable and high\-performance solutions.

 Experience in the healthcare domain is a plus, particularly in environments that require high standards for security, compliance, and data integrity.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintain microservices using Java
* Build and deploy cloud\-native applications on AWS, utilizing services such as EKS and S3
* Containerize applications using Docker and deploy them via Kubernetes (EKS)
